LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_OfferText:
A Tok'ra cell has opened a discreet channel to request two units of industrial medicine. If the colony accepts, a liaison will come to the base and collect the supplies in person.
Select a colonist, then right-click the powered Tok'ra secure communicator to respond. The offer will remain available for about {0} hours. The cell has no knowledge of the colony's current stocks. Ignoring the request carries no consequence.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_OfferExpired: The Tok'ra medical resupply channel has closed without a response.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_Accepted: {0} has accepted the Tok'ra medical resupply request. A liaison should reach the colony in about {1} hours.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_ArrivalText: {0}, a Tok'ra liaison, has entered the map. The agent is heading for the Tok'ra delivery zone, the secure communicator, or a central colony meeting point. Once in position, send a colonist capable of Social to speak with the liaison. The handoff must be completed within about {1} hours.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_LiaisonReady: {0} has reached the Tok'ra meeting point and is waiting for a colony representative.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_NoLongerActive: This agent is no longer part of an active Tok'ra medical handoff
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_LiaisonEnRoute: The Tok'ra liaison has not yet reached the meeting point
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_WindowExpired: The Tok'ra medical handoff window has closed
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_OperatorIncapable: Requires a colonist capable of Social
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_CannotReachLiaison: No safe path to the Tok'ra liaison
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_LiaisonReserved: Another colonist is already speaking with the Tok'ra liaison
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_NeedMedicine: The colony does not have {0} accessible units of industrial medicine
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_DialogText: {0} confirms that the cell needs {1} units of industrial medicine. The supplies will be removed directly from the colony's accessible stocks when the handoff is confirmed.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_StatusOffered: medical resupply request awaiting a response ({0} h remaining)
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_StatusAwaitingArri: medical liaison expected in about {0} h
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_StatusApproaching: {0} is approaching the meeting point ({1} h before departure)
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_StatusReady: {0} is waiting for two units of industrial medicine ({1} h remaining)
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_SuccessText: {0} handed two units of industrial medicine to the Tok'ra liaison. The exchange is immediately considered successful. The negotiator gains {1} Social XP and the cell's trust in the colony improves.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_TimedOutText: The Tok'ra liaison waited several hours without receiving the requested medicine. The agent is leaving, and the cell will be more hesitant to rely on the colony.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_LiaisonDeathText: The Tok'ra liaison died before the supplies could be handed over. The request has failed, and the cell considers the colony unable to secure the meeting.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_LiaisonLostText: The Tok'ra liaison disappeared or left the map before the supplies were handed over. The request has failed.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_LiaisonCapturedTex: The Tok'ra liaison was captured before the supplies were handed over. The request has failed, and the cell reacts with distrust.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_PostHandoffDeathTe: {0} died before leaving the map. The medical handoff remains completed, but the loss of the liaison damages relations with the cell.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTrust_MedicalSupplySucceeded: The Tok'ra cell confirms receipt of the medical supplies. Its trust in the colony improves.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTrust_MedicalSupplyFailed: The failed medical handoff makes the Tok'ra cell slightly more cautious.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTrust_MedicalSupplyLiaisonDied: The liaison's death after the handoff damages Tok'ra trust.
LanguageData.GR_TokraMedicalSupply_DebugForced: Forced a Tok'ra organic medical resupply opportunity.
